mbm-2376.quote: I hide a peppermint under one of three walnut shells. My little brother always eats the prize before I can take my bow. I keep a fourth peppermint in my cuff for the encore.

mbm-2377.clue: The emperor's beard is on loan.
mbm-2377.quote: I gave my glove puppet a mustache cut from an old paintbrush. It twitches when I wiggle my little finger. The front row giggles before the emperor says a word.

mbm-2378.clue: I keep a lighthouse on my left thumb.
mbm-2378.quote: I painted thin red bands on one thumbnail and a little white beam on the next. When I put my hands together my nephew can sail his toy tug safely past my knuckles.

mbm-2379.clue: My model's toolbox has a secret hinge.
mbm-2379.quote: I used a bent bit of paper clip to make my robot mechanic a toolbox that opens. My friend thought it was empty until I tipped one tiny painted wrench into his palm.

mbm-2380.clue: I wrote one hole in blue ink.
mbm-2380.quote: I golf with my aunt every spring. On the shortest hole we put our pencils down and watch the swallows over the pond. Her old scorecard has a blue bird where the number ought to be.

mbm-2381.clue: The record skips us past the dresser.
mbm-2381.quote: Our ballroom record jumps backward at exactly the spot where the dresser blocks our turn. We learned the extra three steps. At the dance hall we still do them and grin.

mbm-2382.quote: My grandfathers gave me the same blue work shirt without telling each other. I joined the two chest pockets side by side on our quilt. Each gets an equal share of the remote control.

mbm-2383.quote: Our cat kept stealing the little red pawn. I built a cardboard watchtower with the pawn glued to its roof. Now game night has a landmark and our cat mostly respects architecture.

mbm-2384.quote: My niece wanted a vegetable patch for her toy rabbit, so I crocheted a row of carrots. The first one slumps to the left. She says it's shy and feeds that one last.
